links.outcome: Readability and sentence complexity of biomedical text before vs after LLM hypernym substitution
links.effect: All three fine-tuned LLM approaches improved readability and sentence complexity; scores moved from collegiate to US high-school level; GPT-J-6b best on sentence complexity.
links.quote: Readability scores were translated from a pre-processed collegiate reading level to a post-processed US high-school level.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning open-access LLMs to substitute complex biomedical terms with hypernyms to simplify text

screen.reason: Evaluates fine-tuned LLM approaches for hypernym substitution to improve biomedical text readability across a benchmark sample of 1,000 UMLS definitions using automated readability scores.
